Hiller Aviation Museum 紧邻 San Carlos Air: Beside San Carlos Airport, Hiller Aviation Museum makes familiar aircraft easier to understand. Build your visit around three questions: how wings carry weight, how pilots see, and why aircraft have different shapes. You need no knowledge of model names. The museum is the main destination; active airport areas are outside this route.
